title: leptodactylon tenuilobum
intro: Leptodactylon tenuilobum, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is native to the Himalayan region and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennywort include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, as well as exhibiting potential neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Leptodactylon tenuilobum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
